meta.name: deck-presenter-mode
meta.description: tokyo-night 默认主题, T 切换 5 主题, S 打开提词器 popup

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 切换幻灯片主题并打开提词器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用终端制作或展示幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Switch slide themes and open teleprompter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often create or present slides in terminal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成带有演讲者笔记和提词器功能的幻灯片，每页包含逐字稿，右下角有主题切换和提词器按钮，以及显示当前/下一页/脚本/计时器的弹出卡片。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成带演讲者备注或提词器的幻灯片时，或用户指定使用演讲者模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份带提词器的演示文档
say.note: Claude 会生成包含笔记和提词器弹窗的幻灯片。

say.text: 用演讲者模式创建一个幻灯片
say.note: 默认使用 tokyo-night 主题，可按 T 切换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude produces slides with speaker notes and a teleprompter popup, including a toolbar with T to cycle through 5 themes, S to open teleprompter, and popup cards for Current/Next/Script/Timer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests slides with speaker notes or teleprompter, or when presenter mode is explicitly requested.

say_en.text: Create a presentation with teleprompter notes.
say_en.note: Generates slides with notes and teleprompter popup.

say_en.text: Start a deck in presenter mode.
say_en.note: Uses default tokyo-night theme; press T to switch themes.
